chunks: No man refrains from hajj except due to a sin, and Allah, Mighty and Majestic, pardons more.

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.اَلْحَجِّ: hajj, the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.بِذَنْبٍ: because of a sin or moral fault
key_terms.عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: Mighty and Majestic; a reverential formula for Allah

ai.seo_question: Why might a person be prevented from performing hajj according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith links being held back from hajj to the spiritual consequences of sin. At the same time, it emphasizes the vast mercy of Allah, عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ, whose pardon is greater and more abundant.
